plugins.name: ux-project
plugins.description: UX discovery partner for designers — turn raw PM PRDs into KB-grounded ux-onepage (md + HTML 一图流) via a 3-phase gated workflow (Understand & Expand → Evaluate & Converge → Sharpen & Ship). v0.4.x adds: phase gates, scenario lenses, JTBD rubric, online-behavior baseline memory, IA + interaction flow output (B&W), 说人话规范 covering all designer-facing text, KB-first background gathering (rule 23), and /ux-project:update for one-command plugin upgrades. Preserves v0.3 cite-or-die, context-memory, stale detection, and AskUserQuestion UI.
